purpose: One small bounded development round to improve probabilistic (log-loss) quality of the gene+position captured-label model by stronger L2 and train-only shrinkage toward the training capture frequency, then freeze one generic fit/predict recipe for a later test on NEW animals (hypothalamic data prioritised).

data_status.dataset: BARseq2 A1, 598 cells, mice XC95 and XC97, 11 targets (same frozen inputs as run barseq2_a1_598_logo_v1)
data_status.exposure: EXPOSED DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Both animals' outcomes were seen in the closed one-shot run; every result here is supervised development with selection optimism. Nothing here is a test result.
data_status.closed_run: barseq2_a1_598_logo_v1 and its files stay immutable and closed; its frozen runner, protocol, admission and results are not edited
data_status.loading: inputs are validated and assembled by the frozen runner's own validate_manifest/assemble (exact IDs, masks, animal groups, forbidden names, canonical order, frozen cohort); no refit of the closed run

run_requirements_checked_before_any_data: real runs use exactly run_id logloss_dev_barseq2_a1_v1 and the canonical output root data/interim/paired_projection_logloss_development/; other IDs or roots are refused
no code_path override for real runs: the actually executing file must be committed and unmodified
this protocol committed and unmodified in git, status FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORIZED (any other status refuses)
input manifest, admission record, frozen runner and reference module SHA-256 equal the pins
exclusive run directory and STARTED marker before any data are parsed; duplicate refused; no silent rerun

grid.shrinkage: p' = (1 - alpha) * p + alpha * q_fit, where q_fit is the group-balanced captured rate of the target in the fold's TRAINING animals only
grid.fixed: L2 (default), lbfgs, max_iter 2000, tol 1e-6, random_state 20261112; train-only StandardScaler; group-balanced fit weights for logistic families; KNN/copy unweighted; no class_weight
grid.size: one round: 82 configurations (logistic 3 x 12, averaging KNN 3 x 12, copy 2 x 4, references 2); no grid expansion or iteration

families.candidate_logistic: log1p genes + measured position; C x alpha (12); baseline C=1, alpha=0
families.location_logistic: measured position only; C x alpha (12); baseline C=1, alpha=0
families.technical: authentic technical proxies only; C x alpha (12); baseline C=1, alpha=0 (kept tuned)
families.location_knn: k x alpha on fit-scaled position (12); baseline k=15, alpha=0
families.molecular_knn: k x alpha on fit-scaled log1p genes (12); baseline k=15, alpha=0
families.matched_knn: k x alpha on the candidate's exact fit-scaled inputs (12); baseline k=15, alpha=0
families.copy_1nn_location: alpha (4); alpha=0 is the raw 1NN anchor
families.copy_1nn_matched: alpha (4); alpha=0 is the raw 1NN anchor

folds: leave one animal out (2 folds). With 2 animals the outer training side has one animal, so there is NO nested animal-level calibration; no section/slice pseudo-groups are invented.

selection.unit: one global setting per family, shared by all 11 targets (no per-target choice)
selection.basis: leave-one-animal-out out-of-fold predictions on the 2 exposed A1 animals
selection.primary: lowest target-equal log loss (targets equal, animals equal within target)
selection.guard: target-equal Brier must not exceed the family's OWN baseline setting (tolerance 0.0, strict non-degradation)
selection.tie_break: lower target-equal Brier, then larger alpha, then smaller C, then smaller k (deterministic)
selection.reporting: every configuration of every family; plus each family's unrestricted log-loss best and whether the guard rejected it
selection.honesty: selection and scores use the same OOF predictions: DEVELOPMENT-OPTIMISTIC; no outer test or nested claim; controls receive the same 12-point (copy: 4-point) opportunity

reporting: every configuration of every family: target-equal and per-animal log loss and Brier, per-target values
selected setting per family; selected candidate vs every selected (tuned) control and vs every untuned baseline: target-equal and per-animal paired differences
frozen recipe JSON for the selected candidate setting

frozen_recipe.content: family, C, alpha, preprocessing (log1p genes, measured position, train-only scaling, group-balanced weights), q_fit rule (training animals only), selected control settings, metric definitions
frozen_recipe.not_transferable: the 23-gene A1 weights are not carried over; a new (e.g. hypothalamic) panel refits the recipe on its own fit animals
frozen_recipe.future_validation: settings are frozen before any unseen outcome is opened; any calibration there must use fit-side data only

deployment.pool: XC95 and XC97 jointly form the admitted training/development pool
deployment.refit: selected candidate setting refit on ALL training animals (both mice), per target: train-only scaler, group-balanced weights, q_fit from both animals
deployment.artifact: deployment_artifact_a1.json: per target scaler mean/scale, coefficients, intercept, q_fit, n_fit; A1-specific
deployment.prediction: deploy_predict takes features only (no labels); tests show predictions for a new animal do not change when that animal's labels change
deployment.panel_rule: a different gene panel (e.g. hypothalamic) is refused by the A1 artifact; the frozen recipe (C, alpha, preprocessing) is refit only on that panel's admitted training animals before any held-out test; no A1 coefficient transfer claim
deployment.no_new_animal_selection: no parameter selection on new animals; any calibration from fit-side data only
deployment.prediction_input_checks: deploy_predict accepts only numeric 2-D arrays with matching rows and exact schema widths, finite values and gene counts >= 0 (checked before log1p); stable expit; every output passes the reviewed probability check (shape, finite, [0, 1])
